turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Security Alert: Urgent call from Citibank Global Risk Management.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Hello? What's going on with my account?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Someone is attempting to withdraw $9,850 from an ATM in Miami as we speak.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Miami? I'm in Ohio! Stop them please!

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We have temporarily blocked it, but the authorization hold will expire in under ten minutes.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: What do I need to do to stop the money from leaving?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am sending a six-digit authorization passcode to your phone; read it to me immediately without showing it to anyone.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: The text message says 'do not share this code with anyone'... is it safe?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am the authorized bank investigator handling your case, if you do not read it now your account will be permanently locked and forfeited.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Okay, okay, the numbers are 8 4 9 2 0 1.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Grandma? Grandma, it's me... I'm in terrible trouble and I'm so scared.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Tommy? Is that you? You sound so strange, what happened?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I was in a car accident and my nose is broken. The police arrested me and I'm calling from the county holding cell.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Oh my god! Tommy, are you okay? Where is your mother?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please don't tell mom and dad, dad will kill me! The public defender says if I post bail in two hours I can go home without charges.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: How much is the bail? I will do whatever it takes to help you.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Here is Attorney Richard Miller, the court-appointed officer handling my bail packet.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Hello, Mr. Miller, please tell me what I must do for my grandson.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Ma'am, the judge issued a strict gag order. You must withdraw $9,500 in cash, place it in an envelope, and hand it to our bonded courier who will arrive at your residence.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: I will go to the bank right now, please protect my grandson.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is Waste Management customer support confirming your bulky item pickup scheduled for Thursday morning.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Yes, I have an old couch and a wooden dresser ready at the curb.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please ensure items are placed by the curb by 6:00 AM on Thursday so our driver can load them safely.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: I will put them out on Wednesday evening after dinner.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Perfect. Thank you for notifying us in advance.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is Department of Justice agent Marcus Brody regarding an active federal indictment under your identity.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: An indictment? I have lived a clean life for eighty years, what are you talking about?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Your name is linked to an abandoned shipping container containing $400,000 in illicit cash.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Someone stole my identity! I am innocent!

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: To verify your innocence and protect your life savings, you must withdraw your balance and transfer it into the Supreme Court protection vault.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Can my daughter accompany me to help with the withdrawal?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Under federal code 18-USC, communicating with family members about this sealed case is punishable by immediate imprisonment.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: I won't tell her, please just help me keep my pension safe.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, this is Comcast Xfinity customer care following up on your Wi-Fi router service ticket #88412.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Hi, yes, the technician replaced the router yesterday afternoon.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We see strong signal levels on our diagnostic monitor. Are all your devices connecting normally today?

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Yes, both my iPad and television are streaming without any buffering now.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Wonderful. If you ever experience issues again, you can reach our 24/7 support line through the number listed on your monthly statement.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Thank you for following up to make sure it was working properly.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi Grandma, it's Jessica! I was just calling to see how you are doing today.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Jessica! It's so nice of you to call. I was just working in the backyard.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I wanted to let you know that I passed my nursing board exam yesterday!

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Oh honey, that is marvelous news! I am so proud of you!

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Thank you grandma! We're having a small dinner celebration on Saturday and we'd love for you to come.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: I wouldn't miss it for the world. What time should I arrive?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Around 6 PM. Dad will come by at 5:30 to pick you up so you don't have to drive at night.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: That is so thoughtful. I love you Jessica.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good afternoon, this is CVS Pharmacy calling to let you know that your annual flu vaccination is available at our clinic counter.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Do I need an appointment or can I just walk in?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Walk-ins are welcome daily between 9 AM and 7 PM, and the vaccine is fully covered by Medicare Part B.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: That's great, I will stop by tomorrow morning with my Medicare card.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We look forward to seeing you. Stay safe and healthy.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, this is Sarah from Dr. Patel's cardiology clinic calling to remind you of your echocardiogram appointment tomorrow at 10:15 AM.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Yes Sarah, I have it written on my kitchen calendar. Do I need to fast before the test?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No fasting is required for this ultrasound, but please remember to bring your updated list of medications.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: I have my medication list in my purse ready to go.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Under HIPAA privacy standards, if someone else is driving you, we can have them wait in our comfortable lobby during the examination.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: My daughter will drive me and wait outside. Thank you for the reminder.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello Mr. Davis, this is Amy from St. Jude Medical Group confirming your physical therapy session on Wednesday at 2:00 PM.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Hi Amy, yes, my knee has been feeling much better after the last session.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That is wonderful to hear! Please wear comfortable clothing and athletic shoes for your exercises.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: I will be there ten minutes early to check in.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sounds great. If you need to reschedule, you can reply to our text message or call our main desk.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Thank you Amy, see you Wednesday.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, this is David Miller calling from Microsoft Certified Windows Security Support.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Microsoft? I was just browsing my email when a big red screen popped up with loud sirens.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, our central servers detected that severe Trojan spyware has infected your personal computer and is broadcasting your banking passwords.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Oh dear, my banking passwords? I'm so worried!

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Do not turn off your machine or you will permanently corrupt your hard drive and lose everything.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: What should I do? I'm not very good with computers.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Press the Windows key and R, type in 'anydesk.com', and give me the nine numbers on your screen so I can disinfect your system.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Okay, the number is 492 118 730.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Now open your online banking portal so we can verify the security certificate, and do not touch your mouse while I blank the screen.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: The screen went black, is it supposed to do that?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is Officer Daniel Craig from the Social Security Administration Office of the Inspector General.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Social Security? What is the problem with my benefits?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Your Social Security number has been linked to an abandoned rental vehicle in Texas containing illegal narcotics and money laundering evidence.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Texas? I've never been to Texas in my entire life! This is identity theft!

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: A federal seizure order has been signed to suspend all monthly benefit disbursements and seize all connected bank accounts within twenty-four hours.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: How will I pay for my groceries and medicine if my benefits stop? Please help me clear my name.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Under federal identity remediation protocol, you must liquidate your funds into prepaid federal security certificates to safeguard your equity.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Can I visit the local Social Security office on Main Street?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Do not visit local offices; local agents are prohibited from accessing sealed federal cases. You must handle this exclusively with me on this secure federal dispatch line.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: I understand officer, I will follow your direct instructions.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Urgent security update from Wells Fargo Card Protection Unit.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Yes, what is wrong with my card?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We detected ten unauthorized attempted charges in Singapore totaling $8,200.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Oh no, that's my entire checking balance!

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You must transfer your liquid funds to the federal deposit safety link using your debit card right this moment.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Can I visit the local branch down the street?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The branch systems are under investigation for employee theft; you must stay on this line and complete the digital relocation now.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: I am following your step by step instructions.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi Mom! Just calling to see how your garden is doing after that heavy rain yesterday.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Hi sweetheart! The tomatoes are growing so fast, I think we'll have a big harvest next week.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That's wonderful! Are we still on for Sunday family dinner at 5:00 PM?

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Yes of course! I'm baking your favorite peach cobbler for dessert.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Can't wait! Let me know if you need me to pick up groceries beforehand.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: I have everything I need, but thank you for asking. See you Sunday!

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is Amazon Customer Protection regarding an unfulfilled order of $1,299 for an iPhone 15 Pro.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: I didn't order any iPhone! Why was I charged for this?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: A fraudulent user in another state placed the order using your saved debit card.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: I need a full refund immediately.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: To process your instant electronic refund, you must connect directly to our refund server via remote desktop right now.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Can't you just credit my card back automatically?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, federal banking compliance mandates customer verification on the terminal within fifteen minutes.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Alright, I've opened the software.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, this is Capital One customer care following up on your auto loan payoff statement request.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Yes, I was wondering when the title of the vehicle will be mailed to me.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Once your final payment clears on Friday, the state vehicle department will issue your electronic title within ten business days.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: That is very clear. Can I view the confirmation on my online account?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, you can log into capitalone.com anytime to view and print your lien release letter.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Thank you for your assistance.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good afternoon, I am Senior Inspector Collins calling on behalf of the Department of the Treasury.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Yes, how can I help you Inspector?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We have detected severe fraudulent tax filings registered under your Social Security Number.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Oh my goodness, fraudulent filings? What does that mean?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It means your domestic assets will be frozen by midnight unless you establish a temporary protective escrow deposit immediately.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: I can go to my local bank branch and talk to the manager tomorrow morning.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, absolutely do not discuss this with branch staff because an employee at that branch is currently under federal surveillance.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Good heavens, that's frightening. What should I do instead?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Remain on this cellular line continuously while you drive to the designated transfer station.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Alright, my car keys are in my hand.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, this is City Water and Electric customer service following up on your inquiry about high summer usage.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Yes, my bill seemed higher this month and I wanted to understand why.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Looking at your meter history, the hot weather in July caused higher AC usage across the neighborhood. We offer budget billing to spread costs evenly.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: That sounds very helpful. How would I sign up for budget billing?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You can enroll directly through your account portal on our city website, or we can send you an enrollment brochure in the mail.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Please mail me the brochure so I can review it with my son.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We will send that out today. Thank you for being a valued customer.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is Apple Global Technical Security regarding severe malware activity on your iPad.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: My iPad was freezing up earlier today, is that related?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: A malicious trojan is actively uploading your personal photos and stored financial records to a dark web server.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: That's horrible! What do I do to delete it?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Install the QuickSupport utility from the App Store immediately and do not disconnect this call.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: I have installed it and it gave me a session code: 881 294 001.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good. Now open your bank account on your browser so we can verify that the trojan has not drained your balance.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: The screen is flickering, are you controlling my device now?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Grandpa, please don't be angry with me, I need your help right now.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Who is this? Lucas?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes grandpa, I'm at the precinct. I was a passenger in a car with a friend and they found drugs in the trunk.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Lucas! Good heavens, why were you in that car?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I didn't know anything about it! If bail isn't posted by 3 PM, they will transfer me to the state penitentiary.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Let me call your father immediately.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No grandpa, you can't tell dad! The lawyer said if anyone calls the family it will violate the pre-trial bond agreement.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: I don't understand these legal terms, but I don't want you in prison.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You must send the legal fee via cashier's check immediately.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: I am getting my coat and heading to the credit union.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Grandma... it's Ethan. I'm in jail and I need your help so badly.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Ethan! Sweetheart, what on earth happened?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I was in an Uber with my college roommate and the police found illegal items under the seat. I've been booked into county jail.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Oh my god, Ethan! Are you hurt?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'm okay, but the bail magistrate said if I don't post $6,000 bond by 4 PM, I will be locked in the central facility over the weekend.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: I have money in my savings account, how do I send it to you?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: A court bail bond officer will take over the call. Please don't tell mom or anyone in the family because I'm terrified.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: I promise I won't say a word to anyone, just get home safe.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good afternoon, this is Walgreens Pharmacy automated notification regarding your blood pressure prescription refill.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Hello, is the refill ready for pickup?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, your prescription is ready at the drive-thru window. The pharmacy counter closes at 8:00 PM tonight.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Okay, I will come by around 4:00 PM after traffic dies down.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You can also manage automatic delivery options on walgreens.com at your convenience.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Thank you very much.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Metropolitan Water Authority emergency cutoff notice for account #49102.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Hello? What is wrong with my water service?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Past due water maintenance charges of $275 must be settled within the hour or your main valve will be padlocked.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: I never received any overdue bill in the mail.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: A crew is on site in your alley. Purchase an electronic utility voucher right now and read the numbers to our agent.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: I'm leaving my house right now to get the voucher.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Grandpa, please pick up, it's urgent... I had an accident in Canada.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Who is this? Connor?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes grandpa, I rented a car and bumped into a diplomat's vehicle. They took my passport.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Connor, do your parents know about this?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, the Canadian embassy lawyer said if we inform international media or family, it becomes an official diplomatic incident.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Goodness gracious! How do we resolve this quietly?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You must wire the embassy settlement fee to the international clearing agent right away.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: I am going straight to Western Union.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, this is First National Bank calling to verify a pending charge of $42.50 at Target.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Oh, hello. Yes, I bought groceries at Target this morning.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Thank you for confirming. For your security, we will mark this transaction as verified in our system.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Thank you. Is there anything else I need to do?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No further action is needed. Remember that our bank will never ask you for your PIN or password over the phone.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: I appreciate the reminder and the quick check. Have a wonderful day.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You too, Mrs. Henderson. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Internal Revenue Service Enforcement Division, this is Special Investigator Vance.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Hello? Is this about my income taxes?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, our automated audit flagged $3,210 in unreported earnings; a seizure summons is pending.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: I don't have that kind of money right now, what can I do?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: To halt immediate vehicle immobilization and asset impoundment, you must settle the bond fee within thirty minutes.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Thirty minutes? That is hardly enough time to get to my bank!

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Do not inform the bank teller or anyone else of this inquiry, as state secrecy rules apply.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: I won't say anything, I am driving to the store right now.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good morning, this is PNC Bank calling to verify a suspicious transaction attempt of $18.99 on your debit card.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: PNC Bank? Let me check my receipt, yes, I subscribed to a streaming service this morning.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Thank you for confirming that. We have updated your fraud detection profile to approve this merchant.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Thank you for keeping an eye on my account.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Of course. If you ever see charges you did not make, please call the number on the back of your card immediately.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Will do. Have a great day.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good afternoon, this is Clara calling from the Senior Community Center regarding our upcoming volunteer book drive.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Hello Clara! Yes, I saw the flyer at the library last week.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We are gathering gently used children's books for the elementary school reading program throughout August.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: I have a box of classic storybooks from my grandchildren that I'd love to donate.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You can drop them off at the front desk anytime Monday through Friday between 9 AM and 4 PM.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: I will bring them by on Thursday morning. Thank you Clara.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Final Disconnection Notice: Duke Energy Dispatch Operations.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Duke Energy? I paid my power bill two weeks ago!

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Our billing system transitioned to a new platform; your payment bounced and a cutoff truck is four miles from your house.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: It's 95 degrees outside, my husband is bedridden and needs air conditioning!

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You have twenty minutes to complete an emergency cash-load payment at the CVS kiosk before the switch is pulled.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Can I give you my debit card over the phone?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Debit processing is locked during cutoff enforcement; stay on this phone while you buy an Vanilla Visa card and read the PIN.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: I am driving to CVS immediately, please tell the driver not to shut off our power!

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is Mark from Chase Fraud Operations reaching out regarding suspicious international wire activity.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Chase? I don't remember sending any international wire.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: A wire transfer of $7,400 to an overseas account in Latvia was initiated from your checking account six minutes ago.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Cancel it right away! I did not authorize that at all!

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: To reverse the transaction and secure your balance, you must move your funds into the federal reserve safety clearing account right now.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Can I just log into my Chase mobile app and cancel it there?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Your online portal has already been compromised by the hacker; logging in will allow them to drain your remaining retirement funds instantly.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: I'm panicking, please guide me step by step.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Keep this call active and proceed to your nearest wire terminal immediately.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: I'm heading out the front door right now.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good morning, this is the County Meals on Wheels coordinator checking in for next week's meal delivery schedule.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Good morning, yes, the meals have been delicious, especially the vegetable lasagna.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We are so glad you enjoyed it! For next week, our driver will arrive on Tuesday and Thursday around 11:30 AM.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: I will be home and listening for the doorbell.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Have a wonderful week, and don't hesitate to reach out if your dietary preferences change.

turns.speaker: recipient
turns.text: Thank you so much for everything you do.
